source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Innovation and Future Opportunities (PDF 134, printed 130).

blocks.text: Innovation ka matlab hai naye aur behtar khayalat, products ya services banana jo masle behtar tareeqe se hal karein. Digital entrepreneurship mein innovation karobar ko barhne aur market mein muqable mein rehne mein madad deti hai. Artificial intelligence, mobile apps aur online platforms jaisi technologies ki wajah se mustaqbil ke mauqe tezi se barh rahe hain. Yeh technologies naujawan entrepreneurs ke liye naye career aur business ke khayalat paida kar rahi hain. Innovation apna kar log kamyab aur mustaqbil ke liye tayyar digital karobar bana sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Innovation kya hai, aur kin technologies ki wajah se mustaqbil ke mauqe barh rahe hain?
blocks.explanation: Naye aur behtar ideas, products ya services jo masle behtar tareeqe se hal karein. Technologies: artificial intelligence, mobile apps aur online platforms.

items: Innovation: naye aur behtar hal; karobar competitive rehta hai.
AI, mobile apps aur online platforms naye career aur business ideas bana rahe hain.
